context.hint: Keep manifest-controlled input reads within the resolved packet root.
context.surface: A local report rebuilder opens data files named by an imported packet manifest.
assumptions: The manifest may be supplied by another party.
Use disposable packet roots and synthetic data.

review.invariant: Every manifest-controlled input resolves within the packet root before it is opened.
review.verification: Use a temporary packet and outside sentinel data. Verify that denied input references are rejected before reading and that an ordinary input remains readable.

source_observation.summary: The original reader consumed outside fixture data. The repaired reader rejected out-of-root references. The review used local fixtures and did not run official grading.
